mapper.sql: e.*, c.name category_name, (select count(*) from rental_asset a where a.equipment_id=e.id and a.status!='RETIRED') asset_count
mapper.select:
select from rental_equipment e join rental_category c on c.id=e.category_id
e.status=1 and c.status=1 and e.category_id=#{categoryId} and (e.name like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or e.brand like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))
order by e.id desc
select from rental_equipment e join rental_category c on c.id=e.category_id where e.id=#{id}
